preprocessing.reason: Raw pixel intensities are 0-255 (profile.json value_range) and DATA_DESCRIPTION.md confirms these are bounded RGB values, not counts; rescaling to [0,1] keeps no single pixel channel dominating a distance computation purely from its raw scale. Not count-like data, so normalize_total/log1p don't apply, and n_features (2,352) is well under n_samples (89,996) so select_hvg isn't needed either.

methods.name: pca
methods.reason: Required linear baseline. n_components = min(50, floor(89996/2), 2352) = 50 per the standard heuristic; plenty of samples relative to components so no overfitting risk here.

methods.name: sparse_pca
methods.reason: Required PCA variant. n_samples (89,996) exceeds the 5,000-sample threshold where kernel_pca's O(N^2) kernel matrix becomes impractical, so sparse_pca is used instead, per method-selection/SKILL.md's size-gated rule.

methods.name: umap
methods.reason: Standard visualization method; n_neighbors raised to 30 (from the default 15) because n_samples (89,996) exceeds 20,000, per method-selection/SKILL.md's size heuristic, for a smoother, more stable neighborhood graph at this scale.
